<translate>
'''Gomah's soldiers''' serve King [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]] and raid the demon villages of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. They fight with melee and small ki blasts. A soldier guarding a Gomah Camp is the scout of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army|Gomah's Army]] raid.
</translate>

<translate>
== Patrols ==

Nothing spawns naturally in the Demon Realm: Gomah's soldiers come from patrols, camps and fights. While players are within 6 chunks of a demon village, Gomah Soldiers show up on its outskirts in waves of 1–3 (a 30% chance every 20 seconds, up to 4 soldiers per village). They attack players, not the villagers.

Some soldiers are bigger or smaller than usual (85% to 135% scale), and their health and damage scale with their size. At normal size they have 600 health, 16 melee damage and 12 ki damage.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gomah Camps ==

'''Gomah Camps''' are palisade camps with tents and a campfire, found on any of the three Demon Worlds away from the demon villages. Each camp has one Gomah soldier: killing it starts the [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army|Gomah's Army]] raid, whose waves of soldiers are far stronger than the patrols.
</translate>

<translate>
== Gomah's guards ==

During the [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah|Gomah]] world boss fight, knocking his [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Eye|Demon Eye]] loose makes him call up to 3 bigger, much stronger soldiers to guard his back (4 at most).
</translate>

<translate>
== Drops ==

Gomah's soldiers drop nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story ==

In the [[Special:MyLanguage/Daima Saga|Daima Saga]], the quest '''The Great Assault''' has you survive three waves of 5 Gomah Soldiers on the First Demon World.
</translate>
